label: PF Backlog 591
title: Enforce per-feature FR/US caps + max_lines in the Go artifact engine (scaled by the profile) and reconcile the three section sources
body:
## Problem / why
requirements.srs counts.functional_requirements is TEXT ("<=N per feature, scaled by complexity"); only a global limits[FR].max=80 exists; the <500-line rule is unenforced. Three section sources drift (prompt template vs config/agent-requirements.json vs config/artifact-contracts).
## Goal & value
Per-feature FR/US caps + max_lines enforced NUMERICALLY (scaled by profile); sections have ONE source.
## In scope
- Go validator enforces per-feature FR/US caps + max_lines (scaled by profile); violations feed the bounded repair (BI-PF-1347) under enforce mode.
- Reconcile config/agent-requirements.json sections to the artifact contract (or remove).
## Acceptance criteria
- A per-feature over-count (e.g. 19 FR for one feature) fails validation under enforce and is repaired to the cap.
- agent-requirements.json no longer duplicates the contract sections.
## Approach
Extend go/pfcore/artifact_contracts.go validate/limits; reconcile config.
